description: Compose FINITE-ANCESTRY-NO-LOOPS-PER-SE-NO-REGRESS with the existing regress-to-finite-grounding path theorem and the proved FINITE-GROUNDING-HAS-SOURCE result. Excluded middle is supplied by the permitted Mathlib classical logic, not a new philosophical premise. Every being has a finite per se path, possibly of length zero, to a being with no upstream per se cause. No uniqueness, absolute uncausedness, existence of a caused being or necessity is inferred. The same three unattributed open hypotheses remain.
